title: portal music discs
description: This adds music discs from the game Portal, a retextured jukebox ("Aperture Science 85.2 FM Radio"), and an achievement.
body: This mod adds 2 music discs to the game, replacing "mall" and "chirp" by C418. It adds some music from the 2007 video game Portal ("Still Alive" and the radio tune). It also adds a secret advancement and a retextured jukebox called the "Aperture Science 85.2 FM Radio".
